gate.surcharge_cap_unset: No surcharge cap confirmed by counsel yet
gate.letter_wording_unverified: The letter wording has not been checked by counsel
gate.suspend_services_disabled: Suspending common services is not switched on
gate.suspend_services_min_days_unset: The minimum days overdue are not set
gate.legal_action_disabled: Legal action is not switched on

receivables.title: Common-fee receivables
receivables.lede: Who owes what and what happens next · as of {date}

empty.title: Nothing is owed
empty.body: Every unit has paid. Accounts appear here once a bill is overdue.

bulk.label: Act on the selected accounts
bulk.selectAll: Select every account on this page
bulk.remindBody: Sends the reminder with a payment link for the oldest overdue bill to {send}; skips {skip} (no LINE or disputed — they still get their statement). The message says "amount to pay".
bulk.planBody: Each account gets its own plan awaiting approval; {skip} skipped (already on a plan or disputed). The principal is what is open on the day it is approved.
bulk.pauseBody: Opens a dispute on each case: no step runs until it is closed, and the owner is told. {skip} skipped.
bulk.pauseReasonHint: Kept as evidence on each case

case.title: {unit} · {owner}
case.panelOpen: The ladder takes the next step on its date; a dispute or a plan pauses it.
case.panelDispute: A dispute is open — no step runs until it is closed.
case.panelPlan: On a payment plan — follow-up waits until the plan ends or defaults.
case.panelApproval: This step waits for a decision: approve and it runs now, or refuse and the ladder moves on.
case.heldByDispute: Waits for the dispute to close; the date moves by the days paused.
case.heldByCounsel: Counsel must confirm it before it is used — this step will not be sent yet.
case.heldByApproval: Waiting for the committee or a manager to approve.
case.willRun: Runs by itself on that day if anything is still owed.
case.pausedForPlan: Paused for an approved payment plan
case.timelineHint: Every event is kept as evidence and cannot be changed.
case.billsHint: Of this owner on this unit
case.openDisputeBody: No collection step runs until the dispute is closed; later steps move back by the days paused. The co-owner is told.
case.disputeReasonHint: e.g. a back-dated surcharge, or a bill the owner says was paid
case.closeDisputeBody: Follow-up resumes where it stopped; the co-owner is told the outcome.
case.closeDisputeBodyPlan: The case stays paused after closing: a payment plan still holds it.
case.approveStepBody: The step runs now. Its legal conditions are checked again first; if they are closed it is recorded as skipped.
case.refuseStepBody: Recorded as refused with your reason; the ladder moves to the next step.

plan.proposeBody: The principal is what is open on the day of approval, split into monthly instalments by the system.
plan.splitNote: Instalments are equal; the satang remainder goes on the last one.
plan.nothingDue: Nothing is open on this unit any more — no plan is needed.
plan.invalidState: This plan was already decided — refresh to see where it stands.
plan.approveBody: {owner} · proposed {amount} · {count} instalments. On approval the open bills get credit notes and the debt moves onto the plan; follow-up pauses.
plan.rejectBody: The co-owner still owes the bills as they are; follow-up continues.
plan.cancelActiveBody: Unbilled instalments are cancelled and billed as one charge next cycle (the original debt, no penalty); follow-up resumes.

ladder.title: Collection steps
ladder.lede: What happens once common fees are overdue, counted in days from the due date of the oldest overdue bill.
ladder.empty: Steps are created from the template once a building has its legal form.
ladder.counselTitle: {count, plural, one {# step waits} other {# steps wait}} for counsel
ladder.counsel: Legal measures (surcharge, notice and lawyer's letters, suspension, legal action) can be switched on once counsel confirms their wording and conditions. Until then only reminders go out.
ladder.cardHint: Change days, channels and approval; it applies to every case from its next step.
ladder.legalLock: Counsel must confirm before it is used
ladder.templateNote: Example — the real message carries each unit's amount and payment link
ladder.templateCounselNote: Only the wording counsel approved is sent; this shows the subject only
ladder.approvalHint: The committee or a manager approves it case by case
ladder.enabledHint: When off, the step is skipped and recorded
ladder.enableLocked: Can be switched on once counsel confirms
ladder.refusedLegalTitle: This step cannot be switched on yet
ladder.refusedLegal: Its legal conditions are not open yet (counsel must confirm). Other changes save with this switch off.
ladder.refusedApproval: Suspension, lawyer's letters and legal action always need someone to approve them.

error.order: Must come after the previous step and before the next

remind.title: Amount to pay for your unit
remind.body: The common fee of unit A-101 is {days} days past its due date. Amount to pay: ฿12,400.00 — pay now with this link. If you have paid, please ignore this message.

surcharge.title: Surcharge under the by-laws
surcharge.body: A surcharge under the by-laws is added to your next bill; the bill shows how it was worked out.

notice_letter.title: Notice to pay
notice_letter.body: Sent in the wording counsel approved

lawyer_letter.title: Letter from counsel
lawyer_letter.body: Sent in the wording counsel approved

suspend_services.title: Common services suspended
suspend_services.body: Names the common services suspended under the by-laws — never water, power or access

legal_action.title: Legal action
legal_action.body: Recorded and told to the office; nothing is sent to the co-owner automatically

paymentSettings.title: Payment rules
paymentSettings.lede: Rules for the whole office, read from the system and changed as a new version with a reason.
paymentSettings.plansHint: Applies to plans approved from now on

statements.title: Owner statements
statements.lede: A monthly summary per owner across all their units, sent on LINE, e-mail or by post.
statements.issueBody: Issued for every owner billed, paid or owing in that month; owners already stated are skipped.
statements.issueNote: The system builds each PDF and sends it on the owner's channels; owners without one go to the printed letters.
statements.panelDue: Record the money once; it is spread over every unit's bills by the payment rules.
statements.panelSettled: Nothing is open on this statement any more.
statements.foot: Figures as of the issue date. If you have paid since, please ignore this statement.
statements.payBody: {owner} · due {amount}. The money pays the bills of every unit on this statement.
statements.paid: Recorded as {count} payments, one per unit
statements.amountHint: What was received; less than due only if partial payments are on
statements.noteHint: At least {min} characters, e.g. the sender's bank or a SWIFT reference
statements.evidenceHint: Required for juristic offices, cash and transfers alike

empty.title: No statements yet
empty.body: Issue the month's statements to send every owner their summary.

letters.title: Letters by post
letters.lede: Statements of owners without LINE, e-mail or phone, printed A4 with the address in the window of a DL envelope.
letters.createBody: Gathers the month's statements to post into one PDF, one page per owner.
letters.rowMeta: {count, plural, one {# letter} other {# letters}} · created {date}
letters.batchLede: {count, plural, one {# letter} other {# letters}} to print and post
letters.printReady: Open the PDF, print on A4 and fold into DL window envelopes.
letters.allOfMonth: See every statement of this month

empty.title: No letter batches yet
empty.body: Create a batch after issuing the month's statements.

plans.title: Payment plans
plans.lede: Agreements to pay what is owed in monthly instalments; follow-up pauses while they run.
plans.recordLede: {count, plural, one {# monthly instalment} other {# monthly instalments}} · {by}
plans.defaultedBody: The remaining instalments were cancelled; what is left of the principal is billed once next cycle (no penalty) and follow-up resumed.
plans.instalmentsHint: Each instalment is billed in its due month's cycle
plans.instalmentsProposed: A preview of the split; the real amounts are set on the day of approval

proposer.resident: requested by the owner in the app

panel.proposed: Waiting for the committee or a manager; the principal is fixed on approval.
panel.active: Running; follow-up is paused. An instalment left unpaid too long defaults the plan.
panel.defaulted: Defaulted; the rest is billed at once.

empty.title: No payment plans yet
empty.body: Propose one from the receivables, or wait for an owner to ask in the app.

clearance.title: Debt clearance
clearance.lede: Requests from co-owners and the certificates issued — only when nothing is owed on the unit.
clearance.newBody: For a co-owner of the unit today; everything owed on the unit is checked first.
clearance.outstanding: {amount} is still owed — it must be paid before a certificate can be issued
clearance.issueBody: {owner} · everything owed is checked again; it gets its number and a QR to check it.
clearance.refuseBody: The unpaid fee is cancelled; the co-owner is told with your reason.
clearance.codeBody: The certificate is issued. This code is printed under the QR; anyone can check the document with it.
clearance.codeOnce: The full code is shown only once; the system keeps only a hash of it.
clearance.whatIssued: That this co-owner owes nothing on this unit on the day stated. The wording itself is in the PDF.
clearance.whatRequested: Waiting: once the fee is paid and nothing is owed, it gets its number and QR.
clearance.footIssued: The QR on the document checks that it is genuine.

panel.requested: Issue it once the fee is paid and nothing is owed; it is checked again on issue.
panel.issued: Issued — the document and its QR are ready.

empty.title: No requests yet
empty.body: Co-owners ask in the app, or the office asks for them here.

verify.genuineValid: Issued through getproperty and still valid
verify.noteValid: Compare the number and unit with the document you hold.
verify.noteExpired: Ask the property's juristic office for a new one.
verify.notFoundBody: This code matches no document issued through getproperty. Check the code under the QR, or ask the office that issued it.
verify.privacy: This page shows only what a check needs — never the holder's full name or any amounts.

mandates.title: Auto-pay
mandates.lede: Co-owners who set up direct debit or a card in the app; it is charged when an advance bill is issued.
mandates.privacy: Only masked account or card numbers are shown; the office never sees the full details.
mandates.revokeBody: {masked} will not be charged again; the provider is told. The owner can set it up again in the app.

empty.title: No auto-pay yet
empty.body: Co-owners set it up themselves in the LINE app once the channel is available.

reports.title: Collection reports
reports.lede: Collection KPI by billing cycle, and the age of what is owed by building.
reports.noCycles: No billing cycles in this range.

budgetActual.title: Budget against actual income
budgetActual.expenseLater: The expense side appears once expense accounting is switched on.

workspace.title: Units landlords linked
workspace.lede: Units in condos not run on getproperty whose landlords invited this office to bill the common fee here.
workspace.privacy: Only the invited units and the billed name are visible — never the landlord's leases or rent.
workspace.unitsHint: Bill the landlord the common fee; they pay in LINE like any bill.
workspace.empty: Units appear once a landlord invites this office and it accepts.
workspace.billsHint: Including bills issued before a link ended
workspace.billBody: Issued to {landlord} at once with this office's numbering and due-date rules.
workspace.amountInvalid: An amount above 0 with at most 2 decimals

office.title: Invite the juristic office
office.lede: Let the juristic office of a condo not on getproperty bill your unit's common fee here; you pay it in LINE like any bill.
office.inviteBody: The office sees only the units you choose and your name as the billed party — never your leases or rent.
office.buildingHint: Only buildings whose office is not on getproperty
office.privacy: The invitation works once and expires as the system sets.
office.codeBody: Give this code or link to {office}; the office opens it and confirms with a phone.
office.unlinkBody: The office loses these units at once; bills already issued stay and are paid as usual.
office.noStub: All your units are in buildings already run on getproperty, or you have no condo unit yet.
office.empty: Invite your condo's office to get common-fee bills in the same app as rent.

join.title: {office} · accept the invitation
join.subtitle: A landlord in {building} invites you to bill the common fee of {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} through getproperty
join.what: Free · only the invited units · valid until {date}
join.name: Office name
join.nameHint: Shown on the bills to landlords
join.phoneHint: A confirmation code arrives by SMS
join.invalidSubtitle: It may have expired, been withdrawn or used already
join.invalidBody: Ask the landlord for a new invitation from the getproperty app.
